**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |

| `skill_name` | string | yes | The skill name (e.g. 'deployment', 'authoring', 'guide') — the bare name, not the loader tool name 'skill_deployment'. |
